description: Every skill, for heroes and enemies alike (players = enemies). Math: scenes/battle/BATTLE_MATH.md.

sections.label: Skills
sections.key_help: Classes list skills by this name, so keep it the same as the Name field.

fields.name: name
fields.help: Display name. Must match the id.

fields.name: ability_type
fields.help: PHYSICAL uses attack power vs physical defense (and damage types); MAGICAL uses spell power vs magic defense.

fields.name: category
fields.help: Ability type (docs/lore/ABILITY_TYPES.md). Talents can key off it; ULTIMATE skills come from tier-5 talents.

fields.name: power
fields.help: Damage: +1% per point over a basic attack. Heal: flat + 50% spell power. Buff/debuff: 1.5% of the target's base stat per point.

fields.name: duration
fields.help: Turns for buffs/debuffs/statuses (buff/debuff skills get +1 so the listed turns are fully felt).

fields.name: damage_type
fields.help: PHYSICAL skills only: fixed Slash/Pierce/Blunt. Leave unset to use the attacker's weapon.

fields.name: weapon_bonus
fields.help: Damage multiplier while wielding this weapon id or type (main or off hand), e.g. two_handed -> 1.25.

fields.name: hp_cost
fields.help: Fraction of the user's max HP paid on use (never lethal), e.g. 0.08 for Blood Rite.

fields.name: status_effect
fields.help: Status applied (35% chance per effect on damage skills; always on status/debuff skills).

fields.name: drain_source
fields.help: DRAIN skills: what is taken from the target.

fields.name: drain_restore
fields.help: DRAIN skills: what the user gets back.

fields.name: drain_efficiency
fields.help: DRAIN skills: fraction of the drained amount restored.

fields.name: turn_delay
fields.help: Turn order: >0 pushes enemy targets back that many places; -1 pulls the ally target forward to act next.
